task.name: Clique partitions of two fixed dense random graphs
task.family: science prize i dense clique partition
task.description: construct() -> two lists of cliques (vertex lists), one per instance from random_graph(n, p, seed) for (32,0.6,601) and (64,0.55,602) in the verifier (both with more than n^2/4 edges). Every listed set must be a clique with at least two vertices and every edge must lie in exactly one listed clique. Minimize the total number of cliques. The score totals clique partition sizes on two fixed dense graphs; it measures a partitioning method.
